mechanism: ATA switches search mode each epoch via diff=(fB-prevBestFitness)/(fB-fW). If diff>AT_criterion run reproduction (pairwise info exchange); else migration toward personal+global bests with inertia AT_w. ATAm adds Gaussian outliers from cB when stuck, with probability tied to diff. Population-state progress sensor drives explore/exploit.
data_needed: Population fitnesses fB,fW,prevBestFitness; AT_criterion, AT_w; optional Gauss around cB.
why_new_for_mis: Transfers to MIS as a regime-mode switch: normalize recent improvement vs fitness span and flip between local exploitation and forced diversification when progress collapses.
quote: If the situation is favorable (the difference in the optimal fitness value between generations is greater than a given criterion), reproduction behavior is performed... Otherwise, migratory behavior is used.

mechanism: BHAm replaces Euclidean event-horizon swallow with R=(aveFit-minFit)/(maxFit-minFit) as per-coordinate absorption probability (scaled ×0.01); else move Xi+=rnd*(XBH-Xi). Population fitness spread becomes a diversity/absorption sensor controlling teleport vs attraction.
data_needed: Per-individual fitnesses; blackHoleIndex; popSize; range bounds.
why_new_for_mis: Fitness-span-normalized 'event horizon' is a reusable diversity sensor—MIS can gate exploration intensity by how compressed the current solution/signal population is.
quote: Instead of applying the motion to the entire star, apply this probability separately to each coordinate... the event horizon is the probability of absorption at individual coordinates of stars.

mechanism: Detect most recent 3-candle FVG (bullish: currentLow>previousHigh; bearish: currentHigh<previousLow). Validate gap size in [gapMin,gapMax] points and IsReacted (≥2 prior wicks into gap). Inverse entry: IsBrokenLow on a bullish FVG (open>gapLow, close<gapLow, breakout size capped) with bid below 400-period MA → sell; symmetric IsBrokenUp+ask>MA → buy. Failure to respect FVG as S/R = momentum shift.

quote: IsReacted() checks that within the look-back period, there are at least two candle wicks inside the price range of the current FVG, which we interpret as a sign of previous rejection of the FVG.

mechanism: Same MLP trained with built-in gradient ADAM (has Deriv) vs external population ADAMm (black-box). On 1-1-1 single-point interpolation, ADAM stalls or explodes on Tanh/AlgSigm/SERF/Snake/SiLU-like paths while ADAMm reaches err≈1e-6 on all activations within ~1000 iters; ACON/RatSigm/SiLU (bounded) are easier for ADAM.

mechanism: TETA sorts universes by fitness; for each anchor draws rnd~U(0,1), sets rnd*=rnd, picks partner index ∝ rnd (bias to better). If current better (lower index): small step ∝ rnd toward partner; if worse: with prob>rnd take large step ∝(1−rnd) else copy partner; self-pair → Gauss local search. One probability jointly sets selection bias and mutation strength—no other tunables besides popSize.
data_needed: Sorted population by fB; coordinate bounds/steps; RNDprobab.

why_new_for_mis: Self-balancing explore/exploit via a single squared-uniform draw is a compact adaptation sensor MIS can reuse when tuning ensembles without stacking free parameters.
quote: The key feature of the algorithm is a single probability ratio (rnd *= rnd), which determines both the probability of selecting a universe for interaction and the strength of the change in anchors.
